lore.common: Breaks into the picnic basket, eats every sandwich and politely leaves the napkins folded.
lore.uncommon: Gives hugs so warm that campers forget they are sleeping in the snow.
lore.rare: Can smell honey through two locked doors and a bank vault. The bees have hired a lawyer.
lore.epic: Shook one tree so hard that every pinecone in the forest fell at once. The squirrels now wear helmets.
lore.legendary: Hibernated so deeply that it slept through an entire century. Woke up, yawned and asked if lunch was ready.

lore.common: Clings to the nearest leg like a tree trunk and refuses to let go until somebody hands over a leaf.
lore.uncommon: Can fall asleep anywhere, including halfway up a ladder in the middle of a sentence.
lore.rare: One whiff of its eucalyptus breath clears a blocked nose from across the street. The chemist is worried.
lore.epic: Hugged a whole forest so tightly that the trees started growing sideways. The birds now need maps.
lore.legendary: Won the national napping championship without noticing it had entered. It is still asleep on the podium.

lore.common: Digs a burrow under the garden fence, then gets stuck halfway because it stopped for snacks.
lore.uncommon: Digs tunnels so straight that moles come to it for lessons.
lore.rare: Blocks its burrow with its own bottom, which is tougher than a front door. Burglars bounce right off.
lore.epic: Dug a tunnel under the whole town in one night. Every manhole cover now opens into its living room.
lore.legendary: Built an underground railway with nothing but its claws. Charges one carrot per ride and never runs late.

lore.common: Hangs upside down in the hallway and wonders why everyone else walks on the ceiling.
lore.uncommon: Finds lost keys by shouting at the sofa and listening for the echo.
lore.rare: Squeaks so high that only dogs can hear it, and now every dog in town howls on cue.
lore.epic: Mistook the street lights for giant moths and chased them all night. The whole city woke up to flapping.
lore.legendary: Mapped every cave on the continent using only echoes. The finished map is one very long squeak.

lore.common: Hums the same two notes all day. It has never learned the rest of the song.
lore.uncommon: Grows its fleece back overnight, so every morning it has a brand-new hairstyle to show off.
lore.rare: Its fleece holds so much static that it sticks socks to anyone who walks past.
lore.epic: Shed so much fleece in one spring that the village woke up under a soft white blanket. The schools declared a snow day.
lore.legendary: Knitted itself into the most beautiful jumper ever made. Wins every fashion show, then sheds all over the runway.

lore.common: Chews loudly with its mouth open during the quiet part of every film.
lore.uncommon: Can go a whole week without a drink, and makes sure everyone at the water fountain knows it.
lore.rare: Keeps so much in its hump that it once pulled out a picnic table. It has never explained how.
lore.epic: Walked across the desert so many times that the sand dunes lined up into a motorway.
lore.legendary: Carried a whole market, stalls and tents and all, across the desert on one hump. Asked for no money, only snacks every mile.

lore.common: Refuses to carry anything heavier than one sock. Will spit if you add a second.
lore.uncommon: Gives the most disapproving look in the farmyard. Even the goat apologises.
lore.rare: Spits so accurately that it blows out birthday candles from across the garden.
lore.epic: Led a protest march of every pack animal on the mountain. Hikers now carry their own backpacks.
lore.legendary: Carried a whole expedition's luggage to the top of the highest mountain, then refused to come down until the photo was retaken.

lore.common: Slips into your sleeping bag on a camping trip and refuses to come out.
lore.uncommon: Swims through the garden pond so smoothly that the fish ask it for lessons.
lore.rare: Squeezes through any gap wider than a coin. The piggy bank is not safe.
lore.epic: Raided every fishing boat in the harbour in one night. The fishermen are having sandwiches for tea.
lore.legendary: Escaped from a locked box, inside a locked safe, inside a locked lorry, and was found having tea with the driver.

lore.common: Sneaks into the laundry basket and makes the clean shirts smell worse than the dirty ones.
lore.uncommon: Does a wild bouncing dance whenever it's excited. It is excited all the time.
lore.rare: One whiff of its musk makes guard dogs sit down and reconsider their careers.
lore.epic: Danced so hard at the village fete that it knocked over every tent and still won the talent show.
lore.legendary: Smelled so strong that the whole forest moved two miles to the left. The polecat stayed put and called it peace and quiet.

lore.common: Moos under your bedroom window at five in the morning, then pretends it was just eating grass.
lore.uncommon: Chews the same mouthful of grass for six hours and calls it lunch.
lore.rare: Runs so bumpily that its milk comes out as a milkshake. The farmer has opened a café.
lore.epic: Mooed so loudly that every cowbell in the valley rang at once. The church has stopped ringing its own bell.
lore.legendary: Jumped over the Moon for a bet and landed in the farmer's tea. Insists the spoon ran away first.

lore.common: Eats every tulip in the front garden, then stares at you as if you planted them for it.
lore.uncommon: Jumps the garden fence from standing still, just to show it can, then walks back out through the gate.
lore.rare: Freezes in the middle of the road so perfectly that the cars freeze too. Traffic waits while it decides.
lore.epic: Grew antlers so wide that it got stuck between two houses. The neighbours now hang their washing on it.
lore.legendary: Pulled a sleigh around the whole world in one night without a map. Says it just followed the smell of mince pies.

lore.common: Has the face of a grumpy old man and uses it to win every staring contest.
lore.uncommon: Climbs onto the kitchen table like a monkey whenever it hears a crisp packet open.
lore.rare: Barks at ships, planes and passing clouds with the confidence of a dog ten times its size.
lore.epic: Chased every rat out of the city in one afternoon. They moved to the next town and sent a complaint.
lore.legendary: Became mayor of a mountain village by sitting in the big chair and refusing to move. Nobody dared to ask it.

lore.common: Spends an hour on its hair every morning and still turns up late for the walk.
lore.uncommon: Runs so fast that its fur arrives a full second after the rest of it.
lore.rare: Its flowing hair hypnotises anyone who watches it run. Several joggers have followed it home.
lore.epic: Won a dog show just by strolling past. The judges are still blinking from the shine.
lore.legendary: Sprinted across the whole desert in a sandstorm and arrived without a single tangle. The hairdressers built it a statue.

lore.common: Its patchy coat looks like spilled paint, so art teachers keep trying to frame it.
lore.uncommon: Hears a sandwich being unwrapped on the far side of the savannah with its enormous round ears.
lore.rare: Never moves without a pack vote, and the pack votes by sneezing. Meetings are very damp.
lore.epic: Organised a relay race across the whole savannah. The gazelles were confused and joined in.
lore.legendary: Led a pack of fifty across a continent without losing a single dog. Every decision was one huge, unanimous sneeze.

lore.common: Digs up the flowerbed to bury one biscuit, then forgets which hole it used.
lore.uncommon: Does every job on the farm, from herding hens to guarding gates, but refuses to do the washing up.
lore.rare: Digs through a garden wall faster than the builders can put it back up.
lore.epic: Dug so many holes in one park that the council reopened it as a golf course.
lore.legendary: Crowned leader of every terrier in the land at a grand ceremony. All four hundred guests barked through the speech.

lore.common: Wags its whole body so hard that the coffee table goes over every time you come home.
lore.uncommon: Smiles so widely that photographers have to step back to fit it all in.
lore.rare: Can pull a loaded wheelbarrow uphill, but only if there is a tennis ball in it.
lore.epic: Leaned on the front door to be let in and moved the whole house a metre to the left.
lore.legendary: Won a tug-of-war against a cargo ship, then dropped the rope to go and say hello to a toddler.

lore.common: Barks at every cow on the mountain, including the ones printed on cheese labels.
lore.uncommon: Knows the name of every cow in the valley and tells each one off individually.
lore.rare: Its bark echoes around the mountains for an hour. Climbers keep shouting back.
lore.epic: Herded a whole valley of cows into a perfect circle for no reason. Pilots think it is a giant clock.
lore.legendary: Brought every cow in the country home in time for dinner. The cows still ring their bells about it.

lore.common: Barks at its own reflection in every shop window on the street.
lore.uncommon: Knows exactly which cupboard has the sausages, even when they are in the freezer.
lore.rare: Stared at a crocodile until the crocodile apologised and swam away.
lore.epic: Chased a kangaroo across the whole outback for hopping too loudly. The kangaroo has started tiptoeing.
lore.legendary: Guarded a vast sheep station alone, rounded up every rabbit, and still found time to nap in the farmer's hat.

lore.common: Never barks, but yodels at the doorbell like it is auditioning for an opera.
lore.uncommon: Washes itself like a cat and looks offended when the actual cat tries to help.
lore.rare: So silent that it steals sausages off the barbecue while the cook is still talking about them.
lore.epic: Yodelled across the valley until every goat joined in. The church choir has asked it to stop applying.
lore.legendary: Won a national singing contest without a single bark. The judges still cannot agree what it was.

lore.common: Trips over its own ears on the stairs, then lies at the bottom looking deeply betrayed.
lore.uncommon: Can follow a smell for miles, as long as nobody expects it to hurry.
lore.rare: Its ears sweep the ground so well that the council has hired it to clean the pavements.
lore.epic: Howled so sadly about a dropped sandwich that the whole town held a minute's silence.
lore.legendary: Tracked a single crumb across the entire country. The trail led straight back to its own food bowl.

lore.common: Follows its nose out of the garden and comes home two hours later smelling of somebody else's barbecue.
lore.uncommon: Knows which pocket the treats are in, even when it is the pocket of a coat in another house.
lore.rare: Found every sandwich in an airport's luggage with one sniff. Customs has offered it a job.
lore.epic: Followed one delicious smell across the city with two hundred dogs and a confused postman trailing behind.
lore.legendary: Sniffed out a single forgotten cheese among a million suitcases and became head of airport security. Still eats the evidence.

lore.common: Looks so much like a lamb that the sheep keep inviting it to their parties.
lore.uncommon: Runs as fast as a racing greyhound while still looking like a cushion.
lore.rare: Hid in a flock of sheep for a whole week and nobody noticed until it barked.
lore.epic: Started a fashion craze in the flock. Every lamb in the county now wears a fluffy topknot.
lore.legendary: Won champion sheepdog and champion sheep at the same show in the same afternoon. The trophy cabinet is very confused.

lore.common: Sheds enough fur every day to knit a second dog.
lore.uncommon: Pulls a little cart of cheese down the mountain and only eats a small amount of the cargo.
lore.rare: Leans on people to show love. Several have been leaned all the way into the lake.
lore.epic: Rolled in the snow so happily that it started an avalanche of fluff. The ski slopes are closed for brushing.
lore.legendary: Pulled a cart carrying a whole mountain village to the summer meadows. The villagers waved from their windows all the way.

lore.common: Barks up the wrong tree every single time, with total confidence.
lore.uncommon: Can follow a two-week-old trail, as long as it smells of chips.
lore.rare: Its bay is so deep that the windows hum along. The neighbours have bought earmuffs.
lore.epic: Chased a raccoon up a tree and bayed until the whole forest came to see what the fuss was about.
lore.legendary: Tracked one raccoon across the country, caught up with it, and the two of them opened a sandwich shop.

names.legendary: Duchess Blenheim of the Velvet Cushion

lore.common: Sits on your lap at the exact moment you need to get up.
lore.uncommon: Its huge eyes can get a biscuit out of anyone, including people who don't have any biscuits.
lore.rare: Charmed a whole café into giving it free cake. The owner is broke and very happy.
lore.epic: Moved into the palace by looking sad at the gate. The royal guards now salute it.
lore.legendary: Owns a velvet cushion for every day of the year, each one hand-stitched with its name. Still sits on yours.

lore.common: Leaves a puddle of drool on whatever you were just about to sit on.
lore.uncommon: Can smell what you had for breakfast last Tuesday, and looks disappointed about it.
lore.rare: Sniffed out a lost earring at the bottom of the lake. The lake was surprised too.
lore.epic: Followed one trail so far that it discovered a brand-new country. The country smells strongly of sausages.
lore.legendary: Solved every case in the detective's notebook in one afternoon, just by sniffing the pages.

lore.common: Its speckled coat looks muddy, so it gets bathed far more often than it would like.
lore.uncommon: Can tell a raccoon from a cat in pitch darkness, and complains loudly about both.
lore.rare: Bawls so loudly at night that every owl has moved to the next county.
lore.epic: Howled at the sky until the clouds moved out of the way. Farmers book it before harvest.
lore.legendary: Tracked a lost hiker through a midnight blizzard, found them, and led them straight to the only café still open.

lore.common: Herds the family into the kitchen every evening, whether anybody is hungry or not.
lore.uncommon: Learns the name of every toy in the house and sulks if you call the ball a frisbee.
lore.rare: Its stare is so intense that sheep walk into neat rows just to make it stop looking.
lore.epic: Got bored and herded every cloud over the valley into one corner. The farmers had sunshine for a month.
lore.legendary: Rounded up every sheep in the country into one field and arranged them by height. Then asked for a harder job.

lore.common: Has a face like a damp otter and wears it proudly to every family photo.
lore.uncommon: Squeezes into any hole in the garden and comes out wearing half the flowerbed.
lore.rare: Will keep digging after a mole long after the mole has moved house and sent a postcard.
lore.epic: Followed a fox down its den so far that it came out in a neighbouring village during their summer fair.
lore.legendary: Out-dug a mechanical digger in a contest at the building site. The digger has retired to a farm.

names.legendary: Countess Borzova of the Long Nose

lore.common: Faints dramatically onto the sofa whenever someone mentions a bath.
lore.uncommon: Folds its legs so elegantly that it looks like a chair until it moves.
lore.rare: Runs so gracefully that everyone else in the park stops to watch, including the squirrel it was chasing.
lore.epic: Danced across the frozen lake on its long legs. Skaters have been asking for lessons ever since.
lore.legendary: Was invited to the grandest palace ball and waltzed with two queens in one evening. Still left before the washing up.

names.legendary: Sir Bostonian of the Bow Tie

lore.common: Snorts so loudly that people think there is a piglet somewhere in the room.
lore.uncommon: Wears a natural black-and-white tuxedo and expects to be seated at the best table.
lore.rare: Its huge round eyes see everything. Nobody can eat a single crisp in secret any more.
lore.epic: Snored so loudly at the opera that the orchestra started playing along.
lore.legendary: Was elected the town's official greeter, and in forty years never once missed a doorbell.

lore.common: Drinks from its bowl and then shakes its wet beard all over your trousers.
lore.uncommon: Pulls the milk cart to market and refuses to let anybody else touch the steering.
lore.rare: Its coat is so shaggy that it keeps finding things it lost in there last winter.
lore.epic: Shook off after a swim and soaked an entire farmers' market. The vegetables have never looked fresher.
lore.legendary: Pulled a fully loaded hay wagon across the whole of the countryside on its own. Stopped only to pose for a statue.

lore.common: Jumps up to say hello at face height, every single time, with total enthusiasm.
lore.uncommon: Stands on its back legs and taps at you with its front paws as if starting a boxing match.
lore.rare: Does a wiggling bean-shaped happy dance so hard that it knocks the sofa away from the wall.
lore.epic: Bounced so excitedly at the park that the trampoline makers have offered it a job.
lore.legendary: Won the world jumping competition by springing over the bar, the judges and the stadium roof. Came back down for a biscuit.

lore.common: Makes the expression of a disappointed grandparent every time you put the telly on.
lore.uncommon: Rides on the front seat of the car and looks at the driver as if it could do better.
lore.rare: Its expressive face can win any argument without making a single sound.
lore.epic: Pulled a face so dramatic at the circus that the clowns quit and handed it the red nose.
lore.legendary: Became the most respected judge in the land by raising one eyebrow. Every case closed in under a minute.

lore.common: Has a fringe so long that it walks into the door, then glares at the door.
lore.uncommon: Follows the sheep around the field so closely that the sheep think it is their shadow.
lore.rare: Herds people too. Guests at parties keep finding themselves gathered in one corner.
lore.epic: Guarded so many flocks at once that sheep from other countries began to travel there.
lore.legendary: Herded an entire city's commuters onto the right trains during the rush hour. Every train left on time for the first time ever.

lore.common: Points at every pigeon in the park with its whole body until someone notices.
lore.uncommon: Can find a feather in a field from a hundred metres away, then proudly brings back the wrong bird.
lore.rare: Has so much energy that it runs two laps of the field while you are still tying your shoelaces.
lore.epic: Ran so many laps round the meadow that it wore a new footpath into the hills. The ramblers love it.
lore.legendary: Ran every marathon in the country in a single weekend and still wanted a walk on Monday.

lore.common: Lies across the doorway so you have to climb over it every time you leave.
lore.uncommon: Is so quiet that it can stand behind you for ten minutes before you notice the drool.
lore.rare: Guarded the woods at night so well that even the owls had to show it their tickets.
lore.epic: Sat on the sofa and the sofa went straight through the floor into the cellar.
lore.legendary: Guarded a castle for forty years without barking once. The thieves gave up and sent a thank-you card.

lore.common: Barks at every rock in the garden as if one of them might be a rabbit.
lore.uncommon: Digs up stones and stacks them in neat little piles all over the lawn.
lore.rare: Moved a whole drystone wall overnight, one stone at a time, to see what was behind it.
lore.epic: Built rock piles across the hillside so tall that walkers now use them to find their way home.
lore.legendary: Stacked a cairn so tall that it became the highest point in the country. Then barked at the top of it.

lore.common: Steps on the stairs one at a time and barks at the top to celebrate every step.
lore.uncommon: Herds the cows by nipping at their heels from below, where they can't argue back.
lore.rare: Its long fluffy tail sweeps the kitchen floor clean whenever it is happy. The family has sold the broom.
lore.epic: Herded a whole stampede of cattle into a car park and made them queue in rows.
lore.legendary: Moved every cow in the county to new pastures without a single cow noticing. It was all done at knee height.

names.legendary: Admiral Chesapeake of the Icy Waves

lore.common: Jumps into every puddle on the walk, then dries itself on your clean trousers.
lore.uncommon: Its oily coat is so waterproof that the rain gives up and goes around it.
lore.rare: Swims through icy water to bring back ducks, and also every lost hat in the bay.
lore.epic: Shook itself dry after a swim and caused a small rainstorm over the harbour.
lore.legendary: Swam across the whole bay in midwinter to bring back a single tennis ball. Expects a medal every time.

lore.common: Shivers in a heated room, then growls at you for opening the window a crack.
lore.uncommon: Rides around in a handbag and looks down on every dog bigger than it, which is all of them.
lore.rare: Barked at a lorry until the lorry reversed back down the street.
lore.epic: Lost its temper at the dog show and chased a Great Dane out of the building.
lore.legendary: Became the bodyguard of a famous film star and kept a crowd of a thousand photographers back on its own.

lore.common: Sticks out its blue-black tongue at anyone who offers it a vegetable.
lore.uncommon: Walks on stiff legs like a stilt walker and pretends this was always the plan.
lore.rare: Looks so much like a lion that the zoo keeps phoning to ask for it back.
lore.epic: Shook its enormous mane in the wind and blew the washing off every line in the street.
lore.legendary: Sat in the palace throne room for one afternoon and was mistaken for the emperor for the next ten years.

lore.common: Snores through the whole afternoon and wakes up only when it smells toast.
lore.uncommon: Walks so slowly and grandly that ducks overtake it on the way to the pond.
lore.rare: Its snores are so deep that they make the teacups rattle in the next house.
lore.epic: Snored so loudly during a picnic that every cow in the field lay down for a nap.
lore.legendary: Was given a seat in the House of Gentlemen for being the most dignified creature alive. Has slept through every meeting.

names.legendary: Lady Cockerella of the Long Ears

lore.common: Dips both ears into its dinner bowl every night and wears the leftovers to bed.
lore.uncommon: Wags its tail so fast that it can be heard from the next room.
lore.rare: Its puppy eyes are so strong that it gets the last sausage at every barbecue in the street.
lore.epic: Found every muddy puddle in the park in one walk. The car still smells of it.
lore.legendary: Charmed a whole palace into letting it sleep in the royal bed. The royals now sleep on the floor.

lore.common: Barks to warn you about the postman every day, then greets him like an old friend.
lore.uncommon: Its coat is so long and flowing that it gets brushed more often than the family's hair.
lore.rare: Knows when trouble is coming and runs to fetch help. Usually the trouble is that dinner is late.
lore.epic: Ran so fast across the moor to warn the village that its coat flew out like a parachute.
lore.legendary: Has saved somebody from falling down the same well four hundred times. The village has finally put a lid on it.

lore.common: Comes back from every swim with its curls full of pondweed and leaves a trail on the carpet.
lore.uncommon: Its tight curls never get wet, so it swims all day while the other dogs wait to be towelled.
lore.rare: Retrieves anything thrown into the lake, including the oars, the boat and occasionally the rower.
lore.epic: Swam the length of the lake so many times that the ducks have started drawing up timetables.
lore.legendary: Brought back every ball ever lost in the lake in one afternoon. The shore is now a ball pit.

names.legendary: Sir Spottington of the Fire Station

lore.common: Sits on the white rug and leaves behind a perfect pattern of spots. The rug is ruined.
lore.uncommon: Runs alongside any carriage it sees, even horses that have not asked for an escort.
lore.rare: Rides on the fire engine and barks at every fire before the sirens can.
lore.epic: Played hide-and-seek in a field of black-and-white cows and won for a whole week.
lore.legendary: Led the fire brigade to every fire in the city before anyone called. The phone has not rung for a year.

names.legendary: Dandie, the Hero of the Novel

lore.common: Has a fluffy topknot like a powder puff and insists on keeping it perfectly in place.
lore.uncommon: Is so long and low that it can walk under the sofa without ducking.
lore.rare: Was named after a character in an old novel and refuses to come unless you read it a chapter.
lore.epic: Its topknot puffed up in the rain until it floated away like a cloud. The fire brigade got it down from the church.
lore.legendary: Became the hero of every adventure story in the library. The other characters have asked for their parts back.

names.legendary: Ruby, Queen of the Whistling Pack

lore.common: Whistles like a bird to call its pack, and confuses every bird in the jungle.
lore.uncommon: Its red coat glows like embers at sunset, so the pack can always find it at teatime.
lore.rare: Can climb rocky slopes like a mountain goat and is very smug about it.
lore.epic: Whistled so loudly through the valley that the birds started taking the dhole's song as a ringtone.
lore.legendary: Led the biggest pack ever seen through the mountains. Not one member was late, because every one was whistling the same tune.

lore.common: Stands guard at the front door all day and lets the neighbour's cat walk straight past.
lore.uncommon: Its ears stand up so sharply that it hears the fridge door open from upstairs.
lore.rare: Moves so quietly and quickly that burglars think it has teleported.
lore.epic: Guarded the city's biggest bank so well that the bank robbers retired and opened a bakery.
lore.legendary: Watched over the crown jewels for a decade without blinking once. The jewels feel very safe and slightly nervous.

names.legendary: Sir Foxhurst, Leader of the Pack

lore.common: Joins in howling whenever anyone plays a recorder, a trumpet or a squeaky door.
lore.uncommon: Runs all day at the front of the pack and still has the energy to steal a sandwich at lunch.
lore.rare: Bays in chorus with forty other hounds so perfectly that the church choir asked them to perform.
lore.epic: Led the whole pack straight through a village fete. The cake stall did not survive.
lore.legendary: Followed a single scent across the entire countryside from dawn to dusk, then trotted home for a nap by the fire.

names.legendary: Lady Setterby of the Silent Point

lore.common: Freezes in a dramatic pointing pose at every bird, even the ones in pictures.
lore.uncommon: Its speckled coat looks like someone flicked a paintbrush at it. It is very proud of this.
lore.rare: Can stay perfectly still for an hour pointing at a pigeon. The pigeon has started to feel awkward.
lore.epic: Pointed so hard at a flock of geese that the whole flock landed and waited for instructions.
lore.legendary: Held its point for so long in the town square that the council made it an official statue. It still moves for biscuits.

lore.common: Bounces straight up in the air when excited, which is whenever it sees you.
lore.uncommon: Jumps into every bush on the walk to see if anything is inside. Usually it's another bush.
lore.rare: Can find every muddy patch in a field and bring all of them home on its legs.
lore.epic: Bounced across the countryside so energetically that it flushed out every pheasant in the whole county.
lore.legendary: Sprang over every hedge in the country in one day. The farmers are still trying to work out where it got in.

lore.common: Runs in circles around the garden as if there were cows there, and there never are.
lore.uncommon: Is the smallest of the mountain dogs but barks as if it were the biggest.
lore.rare: Herds cows twice its size with nothing but a stare and a lot of confidence.
lore.epic: Herded the whole village's cows round the church so many times that the bells rang by themselves.
lore.legendary: Drove every herd down the mountain before the first snow, alone, then waited at the bottom with a smug little face.

lore.common: Howls at the kettle every morning because it sounds a bit like a snowstorm.
lore.uncommon: Sleeps curled up in the snow with its tail over its nose, then complains that the house is too warm.
lore.rare: Pulls a sled so fast that the passengers arrive before their breakfast has cooled.
lore.epic: Raced a whole team of sled dogs across the frozen sea and lapped them twice. The polar bears applauded.
lore.legendary: Pulled a sled from one end of the Arctic to the other in a single night, then asked if anyone wanted to go again.

names.legendary: Peter Paws, Who Never Grew Up

lore.common: Is ten years old and still acts as if it saw a ball for the very first time.
lore.uncommon: Its glossy black coat shines so brightly that it reflects your face back at you.
lore.rare: Wags its tail with so much joy that it knocks things off the coffee table from across the room.
lore.epic: Played fetch at the beach with such enthusiasm that it brought back every stick in the sea.
lore.legendary: Turned fifteen and was officially declared the youngest-feeling dog in history. It celebrated by chewing the certificate.

lore.common: Snores louder than a lawnmower and blames the cat.
lore.uncommon: Its bat ears swivel like satellite dishes, picking up the sound of cheese from upstairs.
lore.rare: Sat down in the middle of the walk and refused to move. The whole park waited until it felt ready.
lore.epic: Snored so loudly in the flat that the downstairs neighbours called a plumber about the pipes.
lore.legendary: Became the most photographed face in Paris by doing absolutely nothing at a café table for a week.

names.legendary: Captain Shep, Chief of the Force

lore.common: Sheds a whole second dog onto the sofa every week and looks at you as if you did it.
lore.uncommon: Its ears stand straight up at the faintest rustle of a sweet wrapper in the next street.
lore.rare: Followed a trail through a crowded market and found the lost child, the lost wallet and a missing pigeon.
lore.epic: Organised the whole police station into neat shifts. The officers now ask it for permission to go home.
lore.legendary: Solved every unsolved case in the city's filing cabinet in one week. Accepted its medal with a single polite sniff.

lore.common: Points at the fridge every time you walk into the kitchen, just in case you missed it.
lore.uncommon: Runs all day, swims all afternoon and still wants a jog at bedtime.
lore.rare: Points at birds so perfectly that the birds land just to see what it wants.
lore.epic: Ran so many laps round the hunting estate that the house had to be moved to make room for its path.
lore.legendary: Ran from dawn to dusk for a whole week without tiring. Finally sat down only because the sofa looked lonely.

lore.common: Dunks its beard in the water bowl and then drips across the whole kitchen.
lore.uncommon: Raises its bushy eyebrows at anyone who comes home late. Teenagers fear it.
lore.rare: Guards the house so seriously that the postman now slides letters under the door from across the road.
lore.epic: Drove a herd of cattle through the market and arranged them in order of size.
lore.legendary: Became the most respected guard in the land by staring down a thief, a burglar and a tax inspector in one afternoon.

lore.common: Brings you a shoe every time you come home. Never a matching pair.
lore.uncommon: Greets the burglar like an old friend and shows him where the biscuits are.
lore.rare: Can carry two tennis balls in its mouth at once and still smile.
lore.epic: Made friends with every single person in the city in one walk. The walk took nine hours.
lore.legendary: Was awarded the nation's friendliest medal and immediately gave it to the stranger next to it.

lore.common: Takes years and years to grow up and spends all of them chewing the doormat.
lore.uncommon: Its black-and-tan coat shines so well that it is often asked to model shampoo.
lore.rare: Can point at a grouse on a misty moor from the far side of the valley.
lore.epic: Bounded across the Highlands so fast that it arrived before the bagpipes started playing.
lore.legendary: Climbed every mountain in the Highlands in one summer and planted a soggy tennis ball on each summit.

lore.common: Thinks it is a lap dog and sits on you. You are now flat.
lore.uncommon: Leans on people to show affection, so visitors keep ending up in the hedge.
lore.rare: Can rest its chin on the kitchen table without standing on its back legs. Nothing on the table is safe.
lore.epic: Lay down on the living room floor and filled the entire house. The family now lives in the garden shed.
lore.legendary: Was so tall it was hired to change the bulbs in the street lamps. Finished the whole city before lunch.

lore.common: Barks all night at shadows and a crisp packet blowing past.
lore.uncommon: Is so white and fluffy that the sheep think it is one of them, just slightly larger.
lore.rare: Guarded a flock so well that the wolves sent a letter asking for visiting rights.
lore.epic: Lay down in a mountain pass for a nap and blocked the only road for a whole weekend.
lore.legendary: Guarded every sheep in the mountains for an entire winter without losing one. The sheep gave it a woolly jumper.

lore.common: Pulls the lead so hard on walks that its owner has started wearing roller skates.
lore.uncommon: Pulls a cart of milk churns to market and greets every customer by name.
lore.rare: Its paws thump so heavily that people upstairs think there is thunder.
lore.epic: Pulled the whole market down the hill on carts. The stallholders woke up in another village.
lore.legendary: Pulled a cart carrying an entire cheese factory over the mountain. Charged in cheese.

names.legendary: Lady Groenia, Shepherd of the Night

lore.common: Its long black coat collects every leaf, twig and burr in the park.
lore.uncommon: Notices everything: a door opening, a crisp packet, a sock on the stairs, all at the same time.
lore.rare: Moves around the flock so smoothly that the sheep think the shadows are herding them.
lore.epic: Herded a whole flock home at midnight without a single light. The farmer thought he dreamt it.
lore.legendary: Took charge of every sheepdog in the country and organised a national herding timetable. Every flock is now on time.

lore.common: Its enormous upright ears catch every whisper, especially the word "dinner".
lore.uncommon: Can jump over the garden fence from standing still and act like nothing happened.
lore.rare: Leaps so high after rabbits that it sometimes lands on the shed roof.
lore.epic: Jumped clean over the harbour wall and landed on a fishing boat. The fishermen let it steer.
lore.legendary: Jumped so high at the island fair that it set a record nobody has come close to. The judges are still looking up.

lore.common: Gets so excited when the lead appears that it runs in circles until it forgets why.
lore.uncommon: Its red coat glows like a fire in the sunshine, so firefighters keep stopping to check.
lore.rare: Has so much energy that it out-ran the postman, the milk float and the bus on the same morning.
lore.epic: Bounced through a muddy field so joyfully that it painted the whole farmhouse brown.
lore.legendary: Remained a puppy at heart for its whole long life and was declared the official spirit of fun at its retirement party.

lore.common: Picks fights with garden gnomes and wins every time.
lore.uncommon: Has a red coat and a temper to match, but calms down instantly for a scratch behind the ears.
lore.rare: Charged into a bog after a rabbit and came out wearing the whole bog.
lore.epic: Took on a herd of cows that looked at it funny. The cows now walk the long way round.
lore.legendary: Was so brave that it was sent to deliver messages across the battlefield of a village tug-of-war. Both teams surrendered.

lore.common: Has a bare, thin tail that looks like it belongs to a different animal. It is very sensitive about it.
lore.uncommon: Plays the clown at every party, then dives into the nearest pond to cool off.
lore.rare: Swims so well that the ducks follow it in a line, thinking it is their mother.
lore.epic: Leapt into the river so many times that the river changed course to avoid it.
lore.legendary: Won the river regatta by swimming faster than every rowing boat. Then climbed in with the winners for the photo.

lore.common: Has to duck under every doorway in the house and still bangs its head on the lampshade.
lore.uncommon: So gentle that it lets the kitten sleep on its head, and stays perfectly still for hours.
lore.rare: Can see over the garden wall, the hedge and the neighbour's caravan without standing up.
lore.epic: Walked through the old castle and the suits of armour bowed to it.
lore.legendary: Waited at the same castle gate for so long that the castle was built around it. It still thinks it is waiting for a walk.

lore.common: Refuses to go outside in the rain and stands in the doorway looking tragic.
lore.uncommon: Owns more knitted jumpers than its owner and wears a different one every day.
lore.rare: Runs so fast round the garden that it leaves a little dent in the lawn.
lore.epic: Zoomed round the town square so quickly that it caused a small whirlwind. The pigeons have moved out.
lore.legendary: Won every race at the grand dog show while wearing a tiny cashmere scarf. Refused to run in anything less elegant.

names.legendary: Princess Chin of the Silk Cushion

lore.common: Spins in a circle whenever it is happy, and then gets dizzy and sits down.
lore.uncommon: Grooms itself like a cat and climbs to the top of the bookcase to look down on everyone.
lore.rare: Its dainty paws make no sound, so it appears on your lap without warning.
lore.epic: Spun round so fast at a festival that it started a new dance craze across the whole city.
lore.legendary: Lived in a palace for centuries, according to its own story, and still expects to be carried up the stairs.

lore.common: Its markings look like little glasses, so everyone expects it to be clever. It is mostly clever about cheese.
lore.uncommon: Smiles at everyone it meets, including people who are trying to look grumpy.
lore.rare: Rode on a canal barge and barked at every bridge so the bridges knew to stay up.
lore.epic: Shook its fluffy coat on the canal path and a cloud of fur drifted into the next town.
lore.legendary: Captained a barge along every canal in the land and never fell in once. The ducks saluted at every lock.

names.legendary: Kip, Queen of the Outback Flocks

lore.common: Herds the chickens into the kitchen and then looks surprised when they stay for tea.
lore.uncommon: Runs across the backs of sheep to get to the front of the flock faster.
lore.rare: Can move a thousand sheep through one narrow gate without a single sheep complaining.
lore.epic: Herded a whole station's sheep across the outback in a single dusty afternoon. The dust cloud was seen from space.
lore.legendary: Organised every flock in the outback into perfect lines, then took a nap in the shade of a very grateful ram.

names.legendary: Lady Kerrigan of the Blue Hills

lore.common: Was born black and slowly turned blue. Still won't tell anyone what it has been eating.
lore.uncommon: Its soft wavy coat feels like a cloud, so strangers keep trying to use it as a pillow.
lore.rare: Takes on rats, badgers and the vacuum cleaner with equal confidence.
lore.epic: Ran so fast across the misty hills that the hills turned slightly blue behind it.
lore.legendary: Was so beautiful at the great dog show that the judges gave it a medal for every category, including "best cat".

lore.common: Is mistaken for a mop at least once a day, and once was used to clean the kitchen floor.
lore.uncommon: Lies down among the sheep and disappears completely. Even the farmer can't find it.
lore.rare: Its thick cords are so tough that wolves give up after biting nothing but hair.
lore.epic: Shook itself after the rain and soaked the whole village fair. The fair is now a water park.
lore.legendary: Guarded a flock for a whole summer while pretending to be a haystack. Nobody has ever been so tricked.

lore.common: Guards the garden so seriously that it barks at its own shadow and the shed.
lore.uncommon: Its pure white coat makes it easy to spot in summer and impossible to find in winter.
lore.rare: Guarded the king's crown so well that the king had to ask permission to wear it.
lore.epic: Patrolled the palace walls so thoroughly that every pigeon now has an appointment card.
lore.legendary: Protected a royal family for so long that it was given its own throne. It still sleeps on the floor in front of the door.

names.legendary: Big Lab, Guide of the Hungry

lore.common: Eats its own dinner in four seconds, then stares at yours as if it has never been fed.
lore.uncommon: Can fit an entire loaf of bread in its mouth and still wag hello.
lore.rare: Swims after anything that splashes, including the ducks, the boat and a confused swan.
lore.epic: Stole every sausage at the town barbecue without being seen. The cooks are still checking the grill.
lore.legendary: Guided a hundred hikers safely down a mountain in the fog. Asked only for one biscuit each, then ate the guidebook.

names.legendary: Lakely, the Brave of the Fells

lore.common: Barks at every boat on the lake as if it personally owns the water.
lore.uncommon: Climbs over rocks and walls as though they were stepping stones.
lore.rare: Squeezed between two boulders after a fox and came out with a fox, a sheep and a lost walking stick.
lore.epic: Scrambled up every peak in the Lake District in one day and barked at each summit for luck.
lore.legendary: Guarded the shepherd's flock in the fells through a whole winter storm. Not one sheep lost, and the shepherd lost only his hat.

lore.common: Lies on the cool kitchen tiles in summer and refuses to move for anyone.
lore.uncommon: Has a lion's mane but would rather share your sandwich than hunt anything.
lore.rare: Dives into the lake to rescue swimmers who were only paddling. They are very grateful anyway.
lore.epic: Shook its mane on the beach and caused a small sandstorm. The sunbathers now wear goggles.
lore.legendary: Rescued every swimmer on the busiest beach in the land in one afternoon, then had a nap on the lifeguard's tower.
